buildings.license: ODbL-1.0 (includes OpenStreetMap ODbL, Google Open Buildings CC BY 4.0, Microsoft ML Buildings ODbL)
buildings.assignment: point_on_surface inside the urban or rural area of day9-yguazu.parquet

satellite.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (collection sentinel-2-c1-l2a, Element 84 Earth Search), TCI true colour
satellite.note: 2026-01-22 was tested first but left 8.1% of the district without data (swath edge).
satellite.processing: bilinear reprojection to EPSG:3857 on the z14 pixel grid, mosaic, gamma 0.85, clipped to the district polygon (transparent outside), WebP q80 XYZ tiles z9-14; fully transparent tiles inside the extent are written as tiny transparent WebP to avoid 404s

streetview_points.road: Overture transportation segments, release 2026-10-21.0, 'Ruta Nacional Mariscal Estigarribia' (PY02)
streetview_points.method: sample every 150 m on PY02 inside the district, count building centroids within 300 m

points.rule: rural, 300-1200 m from urban area, max buildings
rural, -55.10 to -55.04, >2.5 km from urban, min buildings

roads.source: Overture Maps Foundation, release 2026-10-21.0, theme=transportation/type=segment, subtype=road (ODbL)
